title: Reckoner wordmark
description: A firm's lockup: an icon, the name set large and tight, and a tiny widely tracked uppercase line underneath (e.g. "credit partners").
notes: the icon takes the text colour, or the highlight colour with tone="highlight"
name: reckoner-wordmark

props.name: descriptor
props.description: the small tracked line under the name, e.g. "Credit partners"

props.name: icon
props.description: an icon before the name (e.g. a lucide icon)

props.name: tone
props.description: colour of the icon: the text colour, or the theme's highlight (as in the footer)

props.name: href
props.description: where the lockup links to; leave out for plain text
